title: linaria spartea var. expansa
intro: Linaria spartea var. expansa, commonly known as the Toadflax or Butter and Eggs, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the health benefits of relieving anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative and calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Linaria spartea var. expansa include its ability to act as a sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic, making it useful in treating various conditions such as insomnia, restlessness, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
